title: Deployment rollback runbook
text: Rollback starts by identifying the last stable version, pausing new deployments, deploying the prior artifact, and watching error rate and latency.

title: Retry policy guidance
text: Retries should use exponential backoff and jitter to avoid amplifying downstream failures during incidents.

title: Cost review checklist
text: Monthly cloud cost reviews should inspect idle compute, storage lifecycle policies, and data transfer growth.
